scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Oh, it's you again.
So did you try finding
that nutcase scientist
who lives over in Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
哦，又是你。找到住在吉芬的那個瘋科學家了嗎？

scripts.text: Talk About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 談談摩根斯坦

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
You know where he lives
but didn't check it out? Hey,
he may be off his rocker, but
I guess most geniuses are
like that. Still, I think it'd be^FFFFFFss^000000 a good idea if you see him.
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
你知道他住哪兒，卻沒去找他？嘿，他雖然有點瘋，不過大多數天才大概都這樣。話說回來，我覺得你最好還是^FFFFFF去^000000見見他。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
I mean...
It's only a matter
of time until a smart guy
like that creates something
truly miraculous, right?
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
我是說...像他那麼聰明的人，遲早會創造出真正神奇的東西，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
...Hello?
Hellooo? Hey.
Hey! I'm talkin'
to you! Man, I hate
it when you adventurers
just shut up and space out...
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
...喂？
喂——喂？嘿。
嘿！我在跟你說話呢！真討厭，你們這些冒險者總是突然不吭聲，發起呆來...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Heya.
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
嗨。
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Talk about the solutions.
scripts.translation: 談談那些溶液

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
When I was in Geffen
looking for magic items,
I heard rumors of this really
crazy scientist guy. So I got
curious, asked around, and
eventually found this guy.
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
我之前在吉芬找魔法物品時，聽說有個特別古怪的科學家。我一時好奇，就四處打聽，最後還真找到了他。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Boy, oh boy, this guy was
screwy. He didn't even know
I was there the whole time and
just kept mumbling this mumbo
jumbo while working on his
experiments. Words like, um...
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
天哪，那傢伙真夠古怪的。他一直沒發現我在旁邊，只顧著做實驗，嘴裡不停唸叨些亂七八糟的話。比如什麼...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Yeah, he kept mumbling
words like ''Karvodailnirol''
and ''Detrimindexta.'' The
first time I heard it, I thought
it was just crazy talk, you know?
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
對，他一直唸叨著“Karvodailnirol”和“Detrimindexta”之類的詞。我第一次聽到時還以為他在胡言亂語呢，你懂吧？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
But it turns out,
this Karvodailnirol
and Detrimindexta actually
exist. I think they're special
liquids that don't work quite
like any liquids we're used to.
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
不過後來我才知道，Karvodailnirol和Detrimindexta確實存在。我想它們是性質特殊、不同於常見液體的溶液。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Hey, this is one of
those solutions that
scientist kept mentioning.
You were able to get one
of these? Huh. Now, I have
no idea what to do with them...
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
嘿，這就是那位科學家一直提到的溶液之一。你居然弄到了一份？嗯...我可不知道該拿它怎麼辦...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Ah, but that crazy
scientist would know.
I don't remember exactly
where he lives, but I know
he's in Geffen and that his
name is ^0000FFMorgenstein^000000.
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
啊，不過那個瘋科學家肯定知道。我不記得他具體住在哪裡，只知道他在吉芬，名字叫^0000FF摩根斯坦^000000。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Hmm... You better
go around Geffen and
around first. I know for
ask around first. I know for
sure that somebody knows
where you can find Morgenstein.
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
嗯...你最好先在吉芬四處打聽打聽。我確定肯定有人知道摩根斯坦在哪兒。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Um...
Good talking
to you pal. Uh,
see ya 'round. Take
care of yourself, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[商人路易茨]
嗯...和你聊得很愉快，朋友。
呃，回頭見。
保重啊，好嗎？

Coincidence? It's more

[奧雷·杜邦]
看來我們的道路又一次交匯。
這是巧合嗎？不，這不只是巧合，而是^0000FF命運^000000。

scripts.translation: 談談摩根斯坦

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Have you not met
Morgenstein yet? He
lives on the second floor
of the Forge. Although we've
just met, I must warn you not
to get too close to him...
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
你還沒見過摩根斯坦嗎？他住在鍛造廠二樓。雖然我們才剛認識，我還是得提醒你：別和他走得太近...

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Go then, and
may the tides of
destiny carry you
to where you must go.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
去吧，願命運的潮流帶你前往該去之處。

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Time flows gently
and subtly, but no
force in this world
can possibly stop it.
Mankind is not even a
mote in the grand scheme.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
時間悄然流逝，世上沒有任何力量能讓它停下。在宏大的天地間，人類不過是一粒塵埃。

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Ask About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 詢問關於摩根斯坦的事

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
To have goals and focus
is good, but to be obsessive
about one single thing can be
quite destructive. Relax, empty
your mind, and let yourself be
carried by the tides of destiny.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
有目標並專注於此是好事，但執著於一件事可能會帶來嚴重後果。放鬆下來，清空思緒，任自己隨命運的潮流前行。

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Morgenstein...?
The man is obsessed
with conquering the forces
that control our world. But
you seem to be curious about
him for some reason. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
摩根斯坦...？那人一心想征服支配世界的力量。不過，你似乎對他另有好奇...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
It would be best if you
were to see Morgenstein
and judge his character for
yourself. You may find him in
the second floor of the Geffen
Forge. Go: It is your destiny.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
最好親自去見見摩根斯坦，判斷他的為人。你可以在吉芬鍛造廠二樓找到他。去吧，這是你的命運。

may the tides of

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
.....
Welcome.
Hehehehe....
Heeheeheeheehee....
scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
.....
歡迎。
Hehehehe....
Heeheeheeheehee....

scripts.text: Ask about his research
scripts.translation: 詢問他的研究

scripts.text: Ask him to make a new solution.
scripts.translation: 請他製作新的溶液

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheeheee...
You must have heard the rumors about my research. Yes! But since you probably know already, I'll tell you without hiding, I mean, there's nothing to hide.
scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
Heeheeheeheee...
你一定聽說過我的研究傳聞吧？沒錯！既然你大概已經知道了，我就不隱瞞了，反正也沒什麼好隱瞞的。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Actually, you can say my research is complete! Nothing's impossible for my genius! Bwahaha, it's just a matter of time!
scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
其實可以說我的研究已經完成了！憑我的天才，沒什麼是辦不到的！哈哈，這只是時間問題！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Are you still here? Right, you wanted to know about my research. It's actually very simple. I was just trying to invent a super liquid that can melt everything!
scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
你還在這兒啊？對了，你想知道我的研究。其實很簡單，我只是想發明一種能融化萬物的超級液體！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Isn't it interesting? No matter how strong you are, you can't break apart stone or steel, but with my new liquid, you can melt those things, making them soft like puddy!
scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
很有意思吧？不管你力氣多大，都沒法砸碎石頭或鋼鐵；但有了我的新液體，就能把它們融化，變得像膩子一樣軟！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
It can't melt everything yet, but I did find that you could combine things that you could never mix before with my invention. Heeheeheehee~!
scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
它還不能融化所有東西，不過我發現，用我的發明可以把過去無法混合的東西調和在一起。Heeheeheehee~！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
You can make a whole lot of things that you'd never would have imagined possible! I can make you a lot of new things you never would have imagined using this method... as long as you want it!!
scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
用這種方法可以做出許多你想都想不到的東西！只要你想要，我就能用它為你做出各種新玩意！！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
The endorphins are rushing to my face at least 2.1 times faster than the usual rate! Ah! I'm so excited! I... I just can't hide it!
scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
內啡肽湧上腦門的速度至少比平時快2.1倍！啊，我太興奮了！我...我根本藏不住！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
So...
You want me to make something totally new, huh? Hehhehheh! I love your sense of scientific adventure!
scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
所以...
你想讓我做點全新的東西，是嗎？嘿嘿嘿! 我喜歡你這種科學探險精神！

scripts.text: Counteragent
scripts.translation: 中和劑

scripts.text: Mixture
scripts.translation: 混合劑

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Ooh...!
You want to make a Counteragent? Hohohohoho, let's see what we'll need...
scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
哦...！
你想製作中和劑？Hohohohoho, 讓我看看需要什麼...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]

scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]

scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]

scripts.translation:
[化學家摩根斯坦]
它還不能融化所有東西，不過我發現，用我的發明可以把過去無法混合的東西調和在一起。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
I can make you a lot of new things you never would have imagined using this method... as long as you want it!!
scripts.translation:
